title: Faith Lived Out: General Epistles
subtitle: James, 1-2 Peter, 1-3 John, Jude
theme: What does genuine faith look like in real life? Holiness, love, suffering, perseverance.
memoryText: We love because he first loved us.
reviewQuestions: How does James reconcile “faith without works is dead” with “justification by faith alone”?
What does Peter mean by “a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation”?
What are the tests of genuine faith in 1 John?
What does Jude mean when he says to “contend for the faith”?
psalmsNote: Speech, integrity, and the cornerstone (12, 15, 24, 34, 118:1-18, 31:1-8) beside the General Epistles.
